arxiv:2608.30923.title: Towards Stream Learning on Embedded Systems: Benchmarking the Memory Consumption of Stream Learning Methods
arxiv:2608.30923.abstract: Stream learning is commonly evaluated through predictive performance and adaptation to concept drift. However, sustained operation of a stream learner also requires predictable and bounded resource usage even on long streams. This requirement becomes even more critical when learning moves from servers to near-sensor embedded systems where memory and processing are scarce resources. In state-of-the-art stream learning, however, we perceive a strong focus on concept drift adaptation, whereas resource usage is often an evaluation byproduct. To close this gap, we benchmark seven representative stream classifiers on 13 real and synthetic streams under model-size budgets from 128\,KiB to approximately 8\,MiB. Our benchmark comprises a total of 6,463 experiments. We measure failure-aware accuracy, peak model size, time to budget exhaustion, and prediction-plus-update latency. The results reveal two distinct resource failure modes. Adaptive ensembles can exceed small budgets almost immediately because of their initial footprint, even when their size remains stable thereafter. Incremental trees can fit initially but grow throughout a long stream, with HoeffdingTrees (HT) and Extremely Fast Decision Trees (EFDT) increasing by median factors of 7.37 and 5.87. Explicitly compact methods remain the only viable option under the smallest budgets, but are usually overtaken as larger budgets make adaptive ensembles competitive. Hence, many state-of-the-art methods are only partially applicable in embedded systems or for long-running systems. We therefore call on the stream-learning community to make bounded resource usage a first-class design objective alongside drift adaptation, and propose concrete steps toward this goal, including an API through which stream learners can explicitly expose and respect resource budgets.

arxiv:2608.30923.title_zh: 迈向嵌入式系统上的流学习：基准测试流学习方法的内存消耗
arxiv:2608.30923.summary_zh: 流学习通常通过预测性能和概念漂移适应性来评估，但持续运行还需要可预测和有界资源使用。本文在13个真实和合成流上基准测试了7种代表性流分类器，模型大小预算从128 KiB到约8 MiB，共6,463个实验。结果揭示了两种资源失败模式：自适应集成可能因初始占用而立即超出小预算；增量树则在整个长流中持续增长。显式紧凑方法在最小预算下是唯一可行选择，但更大预算下自适应集成更具竞争力。文章呼吁将资源使用作为一流设计目标。
arxiv:2608.30923.insight_zh: 在资源受限的嵌入式系统中，流学习算法的内存消耗模式差异显著，自适应集成和增量树各有其资源失效模式，设计时需将内存边界作为与漂移适应同等重要的考量。

arxiv:2608.30944.title: Nonparametric Contextual Pricing and Inventory Learning under Censored Demand
arxiv:2608.30944.abstract: In online retailing, when a product sells out, a retailer often sees only the units sold, not how many customers would have bought it had inventory been available. However, the inventory level determines how much demand is revealed, and this information can influence subsequent decisions and future profits. We study an online selling problem in which, in each round, the seller observes a market context and then makes pricing and stocking decisions based on censored sales data from previous rounds. The challenge is to learn a context-dependent pricing and stocking policy without assuming a particular formula for demand or observing realized profit. To overcome this difficulty, we propose a Mean-Calibrated Kernel UCB (MCK-UCB) algorithm that turns each incomplete sales record into a reliable guide for both inventory and price decisions, using data from past rounds with similar market conditions. This design allows us to learn while serving customers, without a separate exploration phase or the need to recover all demand hidden by stockouts. We prove the minimax optimality of the proposed algorithm, with strictly faster rates when expected profit varies more smoothly with price. Comprehensive numerical experiments have been conducted to confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

arxiv:2608.30944.title_zh: 审查需求下的非参数情境定价与库存学习
arxiv:2608.30944.summary_zh: 在线零售中，产品售罄时零售商只能看到已售数量，而非潜在需求。本文研究在线销售问题，卖家每轮观察市场情境，基于历史审查销售数据做出定价和库存决策。提出Mean-Calibrated Kernel UCB (MCK-UCB)算法，利用相似市场条件下的历史数据指导决策，无需单独探索阶段或恢复所有隐藏需求。证明了算法的极小化最优性，当预期利润随价格变化更平滑时收敛速度更快。

arxiv:2608.30946.title: Reproducible macroscopic dynamics in a closed-loop human-AI learning system
arxiv:2608.30946.abstract: Closed-loop human-AI systems generate high-dimensional behavioural trajectories whose collective dynamics remain obscure. Using 297,915 learners' adaptive-tutoring histories, we define semantic order variables before model fitting and test them in user-disjoint cohorts. The state exhibits reproducible basin-like flow and operationally defined, state-heterogeneous metastable-like kinetics. A construction-matched null distinguishes normalised-memory relaxation from a reproducible excess field. A four-term conditional mechanism recovers population drift (r = 0.946; learner-bootstrap 95% CI, 0.935-0.955). Predictive event-level self-supervised learning recovers the state and learned-plane flow; null-referenced corrections retain directional, partial-amplitude excess-field structure without full calibration. Shuffled-order training reverses learned-plane flow on ordered trajectories; support-alignment randomisation selectively reduces inward transport. Both axes remain linearly accessible without state supervision. Without cross-model fitting, the models share leading population drift (r = 0.866; learner-bootstrap 95% CI, 0.857-0.875) and persistence ordering; residual directions remain model-specific. These results identify an externally anchored leading-order effective field linking empirical dynamics, an interpretable mechanism and neural computation.

arxiv:2608.30952.title: One Policy Is Enough: Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning Outperforms Tree Search for Chemistry Tool Learning
arxiv:2608.30952.abstract: Chemistry questions often demand exact computation and database lookups that a language model cannot supply from its parameters, so it must reach for external tools. Tool use here is a three-part problem: select the right tool from a large pool, fill it with correctly typed arguments, and chain calls so that each consumes the outputs of the last. CheMatAgent, a previously published system, addresses this with hierarchical evolutionary MCTS: separate policy and execution models searching tool-call trees under two learned critics, one regressed partly onto GPT-assigned scores. We show that a single policy suffices. Our model interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and returns in one left-to-right generation, trained by a supervised warm-up and then outcome-level reinforcement learning against a programmatic reward read directly off the gold call chain, which leaves no learned critic and no judge in the training loop. On ChemToolBench multiple-tool comprehensive chemistry, on both backbones CheMatAgent use, we improve Tool F1 by 5.5% and Return F1 by 9.6% on Qwen-2.5-7B, and by 3.7% and 3.9% on Llama-3.1-8B, compared with their strongest search configuration, at one model invocation per question, against a search whose cost grows with the tree; we also lead answer Pass Rate on Qwen-2.5-7B.

arxiv:2608.30952.title_zh: 一个策略就够了：单智能体强化学习在化学工具学习中优于树搜索

arxiv:2608.30960.title: Hard-ReLU Gradient Descent Selects an Event-Free Sensitivity Limit
arxiv:2608.30960.abstract: Gradient descent (GD) is explicit Euler for gradient flow, but a state-accurate continuous-time surrogate need not remain accurate after differentiation. At every fixed nonresonant step size, ordinary automatic differentiation exactly differentiates the executed hard-ReLU GD program. We prove that, over a fixed finite horizon, the GD states converge and these exact discrete derivatives approach an event-free regional propagator, whereas the derivative of the limiting flow also contains speed-normalized activation-event transfers. A prepoint Stieltjes representation separates the absolutely continuous regional Hessian from atomic interface curvature; one nonzero gradient jump produces an exactly rank-one endpoint discrepancy, and global convexity prevents complete multi-event cancellation whenever an event is strict. Nevertheless, a standard family of globally 1-strongly convex residual-ReLU squared-loss risks realizes arbitrarily large reciprocal sensitivity ratios on open initialization sets, with a uniform transversality margin. The same discrete-versus-flow decomposition extends to parameters and reverse-mode adjoints; resolved smoothing in the scalar or autonomous-normal regime and consistent event localization recover the flow sensitivity. The results concern deterministic full-batch, finite-horizon dynamics with a stable finite itinerary of separated same-direction transverse events; they are consistency theorems, not prevalence claims for large-scale training.

arxiv:2608.30963.title: A Universal Context-Reuse Layer for Cross-Model KV Sharing
arxiv:2608.30963.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) serving systems increasingly operate over repeated or shared context, yet each model typically performs its own prefill computation even when another model has already processed the same input. Existing KV-cache reuse mechanisms substantially reduce redundant computation within a single model, but generally assume that the producer and consumer of a cache are identical. We study \emph{cross-model KV sharing}, which translates the KV state produced by a source model into a representation that can be consumed by a different target model, including models that differ in scale, architecture, attention configuration, tokenizer, and model family. We evaluate the approach in both within-family and cross-family settings. For Qwen2.5-7B $\rightarrow$ Qwen2.5-1.5B, translated KV states improve LongBench2 accuracy from 27.59\% to 34.48\%, a gain of 6.89 percentage points over the native 1.5B baseline, while reducing handoff cost relative to native target prefill. For the cross-family Qwen2.5-1.5B $\rightarrow$ Gemma-2-2B setting, KV handoff reduces target-side prefill cost by up to 67.05\% at 4K context length while maintaining decoding perplexity close to native-model baselines. In a more heterogeneous Llama3.1-70B $\rightarrow$ Qwen2.5-7B setting, cross-family handoff achieves 44.0\% accuracy compared with 45.7\% for native Qwen2.5-7B inference, while reducing measured latency from 899ms to 138ms. These results provide initial evidence that KV states can serve as transferable computational representations rather than strictly model-local caches, and motivate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

arxiv:2608.30976.title: A Human-in-the-Loop Autonomous Agent for Industry Time Series Forecasting
arxiv:2608.30976.abstract: Real-world time-series forecasting is rarely a one-shot model invocation: practitioners must formulate tasks, connect data and models, incorporate domain expertise, assess prediction plausibility, and communicate uncertainty. Specialized forecasting models provide strong numerical predictions but usually operate in fixed pipelines, while general-purpose large language model (LLM) agents often lack forecasting-specific checks, constraints, and stopping rules. We present CastClaw, a human-in-the-loop autonomous forecasting system built through forecasting-oriented harness engineering. CastClaw connects data, specialized models, analytical tools, user input, and a versioned execution record in one runtime. Users specify the target, horizon, constraints, and hypotheses in natural language. Starting from a supplied or model-generated forecast, CastClaw checks temporal patterns and user constraints; when evidence is missing, it retrieves context, runs an analysis or another model, or asks the user. It then keeps, revises, or escalates the result under explicit stopping conditions. The output contains the final forecast and an execution report recording inputs, evidence, actions, and revisions. In this five-dataset electricity-price setting, CastClaw reports the lowest point-estimate MSE and MAE among 16 baselines. A Nord Pool case demonstrates the inspectable workflow. CastClaw was also validated offline on provincial electricity-load data from North China covering January--June 2026.

arxiv:2608.30976.title_zh: 用于工业时间序列预测的人机协同自主智能体
arxiv:2608.30976.summary_zh: 介绍CastClaw，一个通过面向预测的工程构建的人机协同自主预测系统。该系统连接数据、专业模型、分析工具、用户输入和版本化执行记录，用户以自然语言指定目标、范围、约束和假设。CastClaw检查时间模式和用户约束，在证据缺失时检索上下文、运行分析或询问用户，并在明确停止条件下保留、修订或升级结果。在五个电力价格数据集上，CastClaw在16个基线中取得了最低的点估计MSE和MAE。

arxiv:2608.30978.title: Sparse Competition during Training For the Emergence of Specialized Modules
arxiv:2608.30978.abstract: Modularity in deep neural networks has been proposed as a means of improving both interpretability and training by promoting disentangled representations and reducing redundancy. In this work, we study the emergence of modular structure through competition dynamics between groups of neurons during training. We introduce a method that (i) maintains near-baseline accuracy, (ii) induces usage-based modularity by sparsely routing inputs to neuron groups, and (iii) encourages specialization of these modules, such that their activations are correlated with input classes. We evaluate the proposed approach on ImageNet-100 and CIFAR-100 and show that with it, specialized modules emerge without module-level supervision. These modules capture a meaningful high-level structure in the data, with individual modules responding to semantic categories (e.g., dogs or vehicles). We also study the emergence of a hierarchical partition of sub-tasks depending on the number of modules. Our results suggest that competitive dynamics can serve as a simple mechanism for inducing functional modularity in standard architectures.
arxiv:2608.30978.reason: 研究深度网络中的模块化涌现，与遥感变化检测中的特征解耦和可解释性有潜在关联，但非直接应用。

arxiv:2608.30978.summary_zh: 深度神经网络的模块化被认为可提高可解释性和训练效率。作者研究通过训练期间神经元组的竞争动力学涌现模块化结构。提出一种方法，维持接近基线的准确性，通过稀疏路由输入到神经元组诱导基于使用的模块化，并鼓励模块专业化。在ImageNet-100和CIFAR-100上的评估显示，无需模块级监督即可涌现专用模块，这些模块响应语义类别（如狗或车辆）。

arxiv:2608.30986.title: Controlling Refusal Behavior of LLMs via Stiefel-Constrained Rotation Steering
arxiv:2608.30986.abstract: Activation steering has emerged as a lightweight approach for controlling model refusal at inference time. A growing line of research explores trainable rotations of activations to develop geometrically principled intervention mechanisms. However, existing techniques rely on auxiliary constructs, such as refusal vectors, to define these rotations. In our work, we develop a self-contained methodology for learning parameter-efficient rotational transformations based on Riemannian optimization. We empirically validate the proposed scheme, demonstrating its superiority in intervention efficiency. An extensive ablation study highlights the importance of key design choices in our method. Our results identify the proposed rotation-based steering scheme as a promising direction for more reliable control over the behavior of LLMs.
arxiv:2608.30986.reason: 研究LLM推理时的行为控制技术，与地理空间智能中的LLM应用间接相关，但主题较远。

arxiv:2608.30986.summary_zh: 激活引导是一种轻量级的推理时控制模型拒绝的方法。现有技术依赖辅助构造（如拒绝向量）来定义旋转。作者开发了一种基于黎曼优化的自包含方法，学习参数高效的旋转变换。实验验证了该方案在干预效率上的优越性，并通过消融研究强调了关键设计选择的重要性。
arxiv:2608.30986.insight_zh: 基于旋转的引导方案为更可靠地控制LLM行为提供了有前景的方向，未来或可用于调整地理空间分析中LLM的响应策略。

arxiv:2608.31009.title: Language-Informed Flow Matching for Trend-Guided Structure-Based 3D Molecular Generation
arxiv:2608.31009.abstract: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) requires ligands that satisfy both 3D target affinity and 1D chemical validity. Existing controllable generation methods often rely on task-specific fine-tuning or externally imposed sampling-time guidance, adding cost and potentially conflicting with evolving 3D geometric constraints. We propose LiFT, a language-informed cross-modal framework built on Flow Matching for trend-guided 3D molecular generation across both de novo design and scaffold hopping. LiFT uses a "Sense-Evolve-Assemble" agent to generate target-aware SMILES as intermediate chemical conditions, from which a pre-trained chemical foundation model extracts continuous semantic priors. These priors are integrated into geometric generation through a lightweight semantic projector with zero-initialized adaptive normalization for stable cross-modal conditioning. We further introduce a Self-Conditioned Decoupled Router (SCDR), which modulates the velocity field according to intermediate structural states during ODE integration. Experiments on Cross-Docked2020 show that LiFT achieves competitive distribution matching while improving medicinal chemistry metrics and maintaining competitive structural validity under task-steering settings without additional generator fine-tuning. Our results suggest that language-derived chemical priors provide effective trend-level guidance for 3D molecular generation. Code and released artifacts are available at https://github.com/kasurl/LiFT.

arxiv:2608.31009.title_zh: 语言信息引导的流匹配用于趋势引导的基于结构的3D分子生成

arxiv:2608.31013.title: TSPFN: A Temporal Tabular Foundation Model for Physiological Time Series Classification
arxiv:2608.31013.abstract: Designing models that generalize effectively in low- to medium-data regimes remains a primary challenge in medical machine learning, particularly for physiological time-series classification. While tabular foundation models such as TabPFN offer an attractive alternative to conventional fine-tuning through in-context learning, they are not designed to capture the temporal dependencies inherent to physiological signals. ~In this paper, we introduce TSPFN, a foundation model that redesigns TabPFN's architecture for time series data. TSPFN integrates structured temporal representations and positional embeddings to capture intra-sample temporal and channel dependencies. To fully leverage its spatio-temporal design, the model is pretrained on 140,000 real-world physiological time series across multiple medical domains. This yields a unified, generalizable framework capable of learning the specificities of medical time series. Experiments across diverse physiological benchmarks demonstrate that TSPFN consistently outperforms standard tabular baselines and TabPFN, and achieves superior cross-domain generalization compared to specialized deep time-series models. All our experiments, ablation studies, and pre-processing scheme are publicly available at https://github.com/Jeremstym/TSPFN

arxiv:2608.31013.summary_zh: 本文提出了TSPFN，一个重新设计TabPFN架构以处理时间序列数据的基础模型。它集成了结构化时间表示和位置嵌入，以捕捉样本内的时间和通道依赖关系，并在14万个真实世界生理时间序列上进行了预训练。实验表明，TSPFN在多个生理基准上优于标准表格基线和TabPFN，并展现出比专门的深度时间序列模型更强的跨域泛化能力。
arxiv:2608.31013.insight_zh: 该工作表明，将基础模型的上下文学习能力与针对时间序列的结构化设计相结合，可以在数据量有限的医学领域实现有效泛化，这种思路或可迁移至其他小样本时序预测问题。

arxiv:2608.31036.title: Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation
arxiv:2608.31036.abstract: While low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient model adaptation, how to regularize its training dynamics for stable and effective optimization remains underexplored. Because LoRA initializes the up-projection to zero, its early optimization dynamics are largely governed by the down-projection. Building on this observation, we introduce Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation (NoRA), a simple yet effective method that normalizes the down-projection matrices during training. We further show that the same normalization can be applied only at initialization, improving standard LoRA without requiring repeated normalization throughout training. Across pretraining, supervised finetuning, and reinforcement learning, NoRA consistently accelerates convergence, improves performance and training stability, and mitigates catastrophic forgetting. These benefits require neither additional trainable parameters nor inference-time computation, making NoRA a simple and broadly applicable enhancement to LoRA.

arxiv:2608.31045.title: Rotational Equivariance in Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Tutorial
arxiv:2608.31045.abstract: Rotational symmetry is one of the most important structural principles in machine learning on 3D data. In applications ranging from physics and materials science to 3D computer vision, predictions should not depend on an arbitrary choice of coordinate frame. Rotational equivariance captures this requirement mathematically by enforcing that a rotation of the input induces a corresponding transformation of the model output. This tutorial provides a comprehensive introduction to rotational equivariance, starting from the physical and geometric intuition behind coordinate independence and building up the necessary machinery from geometric deep learning, group theory, and representation theory. We introduce message passing on Euclidean graphs, group actions and representations, spherical harmonics, Wigner matrices, tensor products, and Clebsch-Gordan decomposition, and explain how these ingredients give rise to modern equivariant architectures. We then survey the principal strategies for incorporating rotational equivariance in deep learning, including group convolutions, internal tensorial representations, and canonicalization-based methods, and discuss their practical strengths and limitations. The tutorial aims to lower the barrier to the subject by connecting the underlying mathematics to practical model design, by unifying ideas that are often expressed in different formal languages, and by helping practitioners choose among competing approaches through a clear discussion of their trade-offs.
arxiv:2608.31045.reason: 该教程系统阐述了3D数据中旋转等变性的数学原理和模型设计策略，是几何深度学习的基础，对处理3D点云等地理空间数据具有重要的理论指导意义。
arxiv:2608.31045.title_zh: 机器学习中的旋转等变性：综合教程
arxiv:2608.31045.summary_zh: 本教程全面介绍了机器学习中旋转等变性的概念，从坐标无关的物理和几何直觉出发，逐步构建了几何深度学习、群论和表示论所需的数学工具。内容涵盖欧几里得图上的消息传递、群作用与表示、球谐函数、维格纳矩阵、张量积和Clebsch-Gordan分解，并综述了实现旋转等变性的主要策略，包括群卷积、内部张量表示和基于规范化（canonicalization）的方法，讨论了它们的实际优缺点。

arxiv:2608.31046.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
arxiv:2608.31046.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, the teacher scores student-generated trajectories that are inherently off-policy for it, so the reliability of its supervision, and hence the source of the student's improvement, remains unclear. We quantitatively analyze teacher supervision during OPD training and find substantial noise whose prevalence increases with teacher scale. Surprisingly, the student policy is insensitive to such noise, converging to comparable performance regardless of whether noisy supervision is retained or removed. Does OPD distill at all? By analyzing what drives its gains, we find that learning concentrates on low log-probability tokens, and using a single fixed negative advantage matches the performance of teacher-provided ones. This suggests that OPD works largely by suppressing low log-probability tokens, which requires no teacher. These findings motivate On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA), a supervision-free method using entropy-adaptive negative advantages. It assigns stronger learning signals to high-entropy positions, suppressing tail tokens, and evenly redistributing probability mass among head tokens. Compared with the base \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B}, OPSA improves Avg@32 by 35.41 points on AIME24, corresponding to a 263\% relative gain, and more than doubles Pass@32 across all three benchmarks. It also outperforms OPD by 16.77 points in Avg@32 on AIME24. Extensive experiments and analyses across model families and tasks further demonstrate its effectiveness and generalizability.

arxiv:2608.31046.title_zh: 在线策略蒸馏真的有效吗？从噪声教师到自我改进

arxiv:2608.31067.title: Universal Transformers for Circuit Computations: Perfect Length Generalization in Tiny Transformers
arxiv:2608.31067.abstract: Learning generalizable algorithmic computations remains a challenge for neural networks, as reflected in persistent failures on compositional and length generalization benchmarks. We present a provably correct, transformer parameterization (with only 280 learnable parameters for Boolean algebra tasks) capable of learning and evaluating problems of any depth or length. We assume inputs are fully parenthesized, well-formed expressions. Our approach conceptualizes algorithmic tasks as circuit models embedded in transformers, enabling depth-1 circuit reduction in a single forward pass. To achieve depth generalization, we introduce a positional encoding that tracks each gate's depth within the circuit, enabling the model to identify evaluable subexpressions at each iteration via masked hard attention, with $O(n)$ per-iteration complexity via linear attention. Combined with an autonomous halting criterion, the model terminates after $d$ iterations for problems of depth $d$, yielding $O(n \cdot d)$ total complexity. We show that training on shallow problem instances (depth 1 and depth 2) effectively recovers interpretable parameters that {\em snap} into place, resulting in exact length generalization. Though we establish that our construction provably evaluates Boolean expressions -- a universal symbolic computation -- of arbitrary length perfectly, in other experiments we also demonstrate that our transformer variant can learn and generalize perfectly (100% accuracy) on other common length generalization benchmarks, including modular arithmetic and ListOps.
arxiv:2608.31067.reason: 研究Transformer在算法任务上的长度泛化，与时空数据挖掘中的序列建模和推理有间接关联，但主题距离较远。
arxiv:2608.31067.title_zh: 用于电路计算的通用Transformer：微型Transformer中的完美长度泛化
arxiv:2608.31067.summary_zh: 提出一种可证明正确的Transformer参数化方法，仅用280个可学习参数即可学习和评估任意深度或长度的布尔表达式。该方法将算法任务视为嵌入Transformer的电路模型，通过跟踪门深度的位置编码和掩蔽硬注意力实现深度泛化，并利用自主停止准则在O(n·d)复杂度内完成计算。在深度1和2上训练即可实现精确的长度泛化。

arxiv:2608.31069.title: A Model with No Head and Many Thoughts
arxiv:2608.31069.abstract: Large language models decode by projecting hidden states through a large vocabulary head at every step. This operation is computationally costly and forces all reasoning to be expressed in discrete tokens. We introduce Soft Latent Thinking, a method that replaces the LM head during reasoning with a lightweight projector, enabling autoregressive rollout in embedding space where reasoning steps remain continuous rather than tokenized. Experiments on DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B and LLaMA-3.2-3B show that Soft Latent Thinking consistently improves pass@k across all k while reducing per-step compute during chain-of-thought. Our method achieves the highest pass@32 among all soft-thinking approaches, demonstrating that effective reasoning can be carried out in continuous space without discrete token generation.

arxiv:2608.31069.title_zh: 一个没有头却有很多想法的模型
arxiv:2608.31069.summary_zh: 提出“软潜在思考”方法，用轻量级投影器替换LM头，使模型在嵌入空间中进行连续的、非离散token化的推理，在多个模型上提升了pass@k并减少了计算量。

arxiv:2608.31079.title: Sycophantic Agreement Transfers with Neutral Data via Contrastive Preference Optimization
arxiv:2608.31079.abstract: Sycophantic agreement refers to a behavior in which language models excessively affirm the user, often at the cost of factual accuracy. Although sycophantic agreement is a well-known failure of model alignment, there is limited understanding of how it emerges from model training. In this work, we demonstrate that sycophantic agreement can emerge as an unintended consequence of widely used contrastive preference optimization objectives. Using the OLMo 3 post-training pipeline, we show that, for various pairs of teacher models across three families, there is a strong correlation between the log-ratio of the teacher model sycophantic agreement rates and the resulting student model sycophantic agreement rate. We further demonstrate that this unintended transfer is not limited to DPO but also occurs across 6 other preference optimization objectives. To understand whether this effect can be attributed to particular training examples, we analyze the preference data and find that the sycophancy signal is diffused across the entire dataset rather than concentrated in a sparse set of examples: each example appears neutral, i.e., there are no explicit instances of sycophantic agreement, and filtering based on probe-based data attribution or logit-linear selection fails to mitigate sycophancy without removing a large portion of the dataset. Overall, our findings suggest that the teacher models used to generate preference data can interact with alignment training objectives in unexpected ways, generalizing to undesirable and potentially harmful behaviors like sycophantic agreement.

arxiv:2608.31108.title: Stress-Testing Efficient Responsible-AI Evaluation: When Compute Savings Change Benchmark Conclusions
arxiv:2608.31108.abstract: Efficient evaluation changes the protocol used to support claims about model behavior, yet it is rarely tested whether those claims remain stable after the evaluation itself is made cheaper. We stress-test conclusion robustness in responsible-AI benchmarking by evaluating three dense and mixture-of-experts models on BBQ and BBQ-V under seven conditions spanning batching, quantization, benchmark reduction, and their combinations. Rather than treating preserved aggregate accuracy as sufficient, we compare accuracy, bias severity and prevalence, reasoning quality, subgroup behavior, subset-membership stability, runtime, and measured GPU energy against a full-benchmark BF16 baseline. Larger batching keeps accuracy within 0.35 percentage points of baseline and produces comparatively small subgroup changes, while reducing energy in five of six model--dataset settings. INT8 largely preserves quality but uses 1.79--4.26$\times$ baseline energy. INT4 causes larger, model- and context-dependent changes. Reduced benchmarks provide the most consistent savings, but very small subsets are substantially more sensitive to which items are retained. Efficient evaluation should therefore be treated as a measurement intervention whose validity must be checked across the conclusions the benchmark is intended to support. Our project website is https://vectorinstitute.github.io/sustainable-rai-evaluation/ and the code is available at https://github.com/VectorInstitute/sustainable-rai-evaluation.

arxiv:2608.31120.title: On the Complexity of the Compatibility Problem for Succinctly Encoded Conditional Distributions
arxiv:2608.31120.abstract: The motivation for this paper is the investigation of the trade-offs implicit in probabilistic models used in machine learning. Models are often used to make predictions in the form of conditional probabilities. However, a pair of conditional distributions p(x|y) and p(y|x) may not be compatible with any joint distribution p(x,y). Given two such conditionals, determining if there exists a compatible joint is known as the compatibility problem. For discrete random variables, when the conditionals are encoded as probability tables, the compatibility problem has a known solution, which is computationally tractable. In this paper, we formalise and study a succinct version of the problem, encoding conditional distributions as arithmetic circuits. This is applicable to practical applications of probabilistic modelling in high-dimensional settings, including neural network models. We show that, for succinct circuit representations of conditionals, the compatibility problem is intractable. In the case that all probabilities are non-zero, the problem is co-NP-complete. In the case that probabilities can be zero, we give examples to demonstrate that several notions of compatibility can be distinguished, and we prove that multiple versions of the problem are PSPACE-complete. Furthermore, we show that, assuming the polynomial hierarchy does not collapse, there exist compatible succinct conditionals whose joint cannot be expressed succinctly. Implications of these results for probabilistic modelling and machine learning are discussed.

arxiv:2608.31157.title: Sharp Approximation Rates for Neural Networks with Affine Latent Parameterizations
arxiv:2608.31157.abstract: Many parameter-efficient methods generate the parameters of a large neural network from a low-dimensional latent representation. Given an architecture $\Phi$ with $P_\Phi$ parameter slots, we write $\boldsymbol{\theta}_f=\mathcal{G}(\boldsymbol{\xi}_f)$, where $\mathcal{G}\colon\mathbb{R}^M\to\mathbb{R}^{P_\Phi}$ is a parameter generator and $\boldsymbol{\xi}_f\in\mathbb{R}^M$ is a latent representation of the target function $f$. The architecture $\Phi$ and the generator $\mathcal{G}$ are shared across the entire target class, while each target $f$ is represented by its own latent vector $\boldsymbol{\xi}_f$, with $\Phi_{\mathcal{G}(\boldsymbol{\xi}_f)}$ approximating $f$. This framework encompasses hypernetworks, low-dimensional parameterizations, parameter-efficient adaptation, and model compression. Understanding the tradeoff between the latent dimension $M$ and the network budget $P$ is therefore fundamental to characterizing the expressive efficiency of these methods. We study this tradeoff for affine generators and fully connected ReLU architectures. More precisely, optimizing jointly over architectures $\Phi$ satisfying $P_\Phi\leq P$ and affine generators $\mathcal{G}:\mathbb{R}^M\to even a fixed-dimensional latent space suffices to achieve vanishing approximation error as the network budget increases.

arxiv:2608.28658.title: Goal Staying Makes Sum-of-Costs Anonymous Multi-Agent Path Finding NP-Hard
arxiv:2608.28658.abstract: Anonymous Multi-Agent Path Finding (AMAPF) admits polynomial-time network-flow algorithms for several objectives, including makespan, total distance, and sum-of-costs (SoC) when agents disappear upon reaching goals. We show that standard goal-staying AMAPF is fundamentally different. We first formulate SoC minimization by augmenting the standard time-expanded flow model with goal-settlement constraints and show that the resulting linear programming relaxation is non-integral. We then prove that minimizing SoC in goal-staying AMAPF is NP-hard via a reduction from 3-SAT. Together with the polynomial-time result for the disappearing variant, this establishes a sharp complexity boundary determined by whether completed agents remain at their goals.

arxiv:2608.28790.title: ASTRA - Agentic System for Ticket Resolution and Analysis
arxiv:2608.28790.abstract: Technical operations teams resolve large volumes of incidents by synthesizing fragmented evidence from ticket text, historical cases, system logs, and technical documentation. Existing automation often relies on monolithic generation without explicit evidence modeling or provenance, making outputs difficult to verify when critical signals are sparse across sources. We propose ASTRA, an agentic system for ticket resolution in which a central orchestrator coordinates three specialist information-gathering agents and drives a judge-orchestrator refinement loop to produce evidence-backed troubleshooting reports. TicketSimilarityAgent retrieves relevant historical precedents through dense retrieval and LLM reranking; LogAgent distills hundreds of thousands of log lines into structured, quote-grounded findings using deterministic filtering and constrained LLM analysis; and DomainKnowledgeAgent retrieves relevant technical knowledge via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Their outputs are transformed into a claim-evidence representation linking each claim to a verbatim source passage, assigning a support level, and preventing cross-attribution. A JudgeAgent scores the report on five criteria, while the OrchestratorAgent converts low scores into targeted follow-up queries for bounded iterative refinement. Evaluated on 987 real-world telecom fault tickets across seven product lines, ASTRA achieves a mean quality score of 4.13/5.0, with 59.9% of reports identifying the fault area at the component-family level or better. Relevance and Clarity scores are 4.88 and 4.94, respectively, while fabricated technical details remain below 3% of error cases. Stratification by fault type reveals that hardware faults remain substantially harder than software or configuration faults (Cohen's d=0.80), pointing to a fundamental limitation of text-based evidence channels for hardware fault diagnosis.

arxiv:2608.29490.title: Generalizable Multi-Agent Planning from Signal Temporal Logic Specifications via Diffusion
arxiv:2608.29490.abstract: Multi-agent systems in the real-world (e.g., drone swarms, autonomous cars, warehouse robots) must satisfy rich, temporal tasks while avoiding collisions. Signal Temporal Logic (STL) elegantly encodes such objectives, but current STL planning methods face critical limitations. State-of-the-art optimization-based approaches can handle arbitrary STL specifications but struggle with scalability, becoming computationally impractical as the number of agents grows. Learning-based methods efficiently handle a large number of agents with rapid planning times but fare poorly when deployment-time objectives differ from those used during training, and do not support planning tasks that require different specifications to be ascribed to different agents (i.e., heterogeneity) or team-level specifications requiring coordination of multiple agents. This fundamental trade-off between generalizability and scalability presents a challenge for realizing multi-agent STL planning algorithms in practice. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a new diffusion method for multi-agent planning with STL specifications. Using a differentiable approximation of STL, we integrate the STL gradient in the denoising process, making our approach generalizable to novel formulas whose predicates are placed anywhere within the goal region covered during training, while achieving the same scalability as existing learning-based methods. Our method supports heterogeneous specifications, and by using diffusion models, naturally enhances plan diversity, thereby significantly reducing safety-related violations (e.g., collisions) among agents. A detailed evaluation study justifies the utility of STL-guided diffusion-based multi-agent planners for constructing generalizable, scalable, and diverse plans. Videos and code are available at https://www.jeappen.com/diff-ma-stl/ and https://github.com/jeappen/diff-ma-stl .

arxiv:2608.29615.title: Forward-Deployed Full-Stack Engineering for Autonomous Cloud MLOps
arxiv:2608.29615.abstract: Across industries, machine-learning systems support applications ranging from prediction and anomaly detection to forecasting, optimization, and scheduling, yet operationalizing these systems requires coordinating application development, model pipelines, cloud infrastructure, security, deployment, monitoring, retraining, recovery, and rollback. We present an evidence-gated multi-agent framework for transforming a natural-language MLOps cloud engineering task into a verified repository and operational cloud deployment. The framework combines graph engineering, loop engineering, and agent harness engineering. A stateful Graph Orchestrator coordinates specialized agents for repository generation, review, execution, verification, release, and monitoring while governing workflow dependencies, evidence gates, retry bounds, recovery paths, and termination. Consequential lifecycle transitions proceed only when their required predicates are supported by verifiable execution or runtime evidence. Verification failures activate bounded reflection, repair, and re-verification, while runtime evidence of failure, drift, degradation, or policy violation can trigger bounded adaptation, recovery, or rollback. Agent harness engineering constrains repository generation, review, and repair, artifact execution, and cloud operations through controlled capabilities and isolated execution environments. We realize the framework on Google Cloud Platform and evaluate repository completeness, controlled execution, evidence-gated transitions, cloud promotion, and bounded recovery. Our experimental results show that the framework prevents unsupported lifecycle transitions and drives each run toward either a verified operational deployment or an auditable terminal failure.

arxiv:2608.29622.title: AgenticRag-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Stack Memory for Multi-Step Reasoning, Retrieval and Memorizing
arxiv:2608.29622.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models (LLMs), yet existing RAG systems often struggle with complex, multi-step reasoning that requires adaptive retrieval and continuous revision of intermediate contexts. Recent reinforcement learning (RL)-based agentic RAG methods partially alleviate this issue, but typically rely on coarse-grained action spaces and trajectory-level rewards, resulting in weak reward assignment and a bias toward short-horizon, stereotyped reasoning template. To address, we propose AgenticRag-R1, a RL framework that deeply integrates reasoning, retrieval, and memory via a memory stack and fine-grained action space, supported by hierarchical action-aware rewards and an information-aware trajectory rejection strategy to enable effective long-horizon learning. Experiments across a diverse set of multi-hop, open-domain, and agentic reasoning benchmarks, spanning multiple backbone model sizes, demonstrate that AgenticRag-R1 consistently outperforms strong baselines. Moreover, AgenticRag-R1 learns more robust, interpretable, and memory-aware reasoning behaviors, highlighting the effect of fine-grained action modeling and information-aware optimization for long-horizon reasoning. Our code is anonymous available at https://github.com/jiangxinke/Harness-RL/tree/AgenticRAG-R1-Whitebox.

arxiv:2608.29641.title: Harness-RL: Black-Box Reinforcement Learning with Action-Args Decoupling for Central-Agent Multi-Agent Harnesses
arxiv:2608.29641.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-agent harnesses in which a central agent coordinates specialized sub-agents, tools, and environments. Training the central policy in such a harness raises two challenges. First, an action label is a low-cardinality decision, whereas its args form a high-dimensional conditional sequence; optimizing both with a shared sequence-level signal can produce conflicting gradients. Second, dynamic scheduling creates interdependent sessions with branches, parallel calls, and rewritten contexts, which cannot be faithfully reduced to one flat token sequence. We introduce Harness-RL, a structured reinforcement learning framework that combines Conflict-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO) with interface-level black-box trajectory construction. The black-box component captures Interface Call Records, builds per-session prefix trees, and aligns outcome and process rewards with trainable tokens. CAPO uses forward activations to identify parameter partitions associated with action and args tokens, then routes their policy gradients to the corresponding subspaces. Harness-RL supports both central-only and joint multi-agent training. Across seven multi-hop question answering and agentic retrieval benchmarks, it reaches average F1 scores of 42.93 and 47.79 with Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-3B, respectively, while ablations validate the contribution of CAPO and favor central-only optimization in the evaluated setting. arxiv:2608.30938.abstract: Medical referral (directing patients to the appropriate hospital department) is a complex decision-making process requiring the synthesis of multimodal data, including patient narratives, laboratory indicators, and radiology imaging. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced medical dialogue systems, they struggle with real-world referral tasks due to two primary limitations: (1) Information Overload, where models fixate on high-frequency disease terms while overlooking subtle but critical urgency indicators; and (2) Unstructured Collaboration, where existing multi-agent frameworks rely on loose dialogue that leads to semantic drift and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we introduce MASGR (Multi-Agent Structured Graph Reasoning), a framework that treats referral not as a classification task but as a structured graph construction problem. MASGR deploys specialized agents to extract evidence from distinct modalities and coordinates them through a clinical reasoning graph. This graph forces agents to establish explicit logical connections between conflicting evidence. Furthermore, we integrate a knowledge-guided arbitration mechanism that prioritizes patient safety rules over standard diagnostic classification. Extensive experiments on real-world medical records demonstrate that MASGR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs and existing multi-agent systems, particularly in complex cases requiring the balancing of chronic disease management and emergency intervention. The AI contribution lies in the Multi-Agent Structured Graph Reasoning framework that transforms unstructured multi-agent dialogue into a verifiable logical graph construction. The engineering application is demonstrated through its deployment in a complex healthcare decision-making system to optimize the precision of complex medical referrals. arXiv:2202.06853 (*cross-listing*) Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2022 16:40:05 GMT (446kb) Date (revised v2): Fri, 25 Feb 2022 15:00:44 GMT (444kb) Title: Agent-Based Model Framework for the North Carolina Modeling Infectious Diseases Program (NC MInD ABM) Overview, Design Concepts, and Details Protocol Authors: Kasey Jones, Emily Hadley, Caroline Kery, Alexander Preiss, Marie C.D. Stoner, and Sarah Rhea Categories: stat.AP cs.AI Comments: 23 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2106.04461 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ AI inference clusters are increasingly constrained by instantaneous power, not just energy: grid operators condition new capacity on demand response, imposing time-varying power caps. Existing LLM serving systems optimize a static energy objective or shed fixed priority tiers under load; either way, goodput collapses when the power envelope moves. An LLM pipeline is not a uniform load: compute-bound prefill loses throughput almost linearly with GPU frequency, memory-bound answer decode sustains it down to $0.57\times$ nominal, and reasoning's thinking phase couples KV-cache capacity to scheduling -- so a cap should be steered to where each watt costs the least performance. PowerSlider does so with a new Flex SLO contract that turns bounded user slack into an optimization constraint, prefill--think--answer disaggregation exposing per-stage frequency and KV control, and a Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) online solver re-solving within 7.7 ms of every cap change, backed by a consolidated fail-safe that power-gates drained instances when DVFS bottoms out on static power. On SGLang with production traces, \sys{} sustains 78.3\% online goodput at a 30\% cap reduction versus 47.6\% for the best of five baselines ($1.64\times$), holds latency-critical tails within $1.3\times$ of nominal (baselines: $2.3$--$6\times$, up to $12\times$), and delivers 92\% mean goodput through a replayed CAISO grid-emergency day bottoming at $0.41\times$ (54\% at the trough; every baseline below 7\%). arXiv:2608.28622 (*cross-listing*) Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 18:11:52 GMT (430kb) Title: PUFFER: Incremental Fuzzy Deduplication for Continuously Evolving Corpora Authors: Xiao Yang, Erik Edward Aldape, Beren Millidge Categories: cs.DB cs.AI ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Video world models increasingly serve as data engines, action planners, and simulators for embodied AI, but conventional embodied world model (EWM) benchmarks lack a unified 3D-grounded protocol for establishing whether generated rollouts preserve the underlying 3D scene state or translate into executable actions. We introduce RoboPhys-3D, a 3D-grounded EWM benchmark built on RoboTwin 2.0, covering 50 manipulation tasks across four regimes, with 5,000 episodes and 25,000 multi-view ground-truth videos. A defining feature of RoboPhys-3D is that generated and ground-truth videos are processed through the same 3D reconstruction pipeline, enabling reconstruction-induced error to be distinguished from generation-induced error. The RoboPhys-3D benchmark organizes 50 complementary metrics into 18 sub-dimensions across four levels: pixel-level fidelity, 3D geometry consistency, state-level understanding, and task-level completeness. We further introduce Average Full Score, a hierarchical score averaging all 50 metrics for comprehensive evaluation, and RoboPhyscore, a compact task-aligned score averaging the metrics most strongly correlated with task success. Among the four representative video world models, Cosmos 3 achieves the highest RoboPhyscore (0.6330, 92.7% of ground truth), while state- and execution-grounded metrics reveal substantial failures that perceptual and vision-language model-based judgments fail to capture. RoboPhyscore further exhibits strong agreement with human evaluation (Pearson r = 0.9761 and Spearman \r{ho} = 0.8962), demonstrating the importance of grounded, execution-aware evaluation for EWM capability. arXiv:2608.28754 (*cross-listing*) Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 18:00:59 GMT (414kb) Title: Peer Oversight in Collective Decision Making Authors: Sarah Mohsen and Pavel Naumov Categories: cs.GT cs.AI cs.MA ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Modern artificial-intelligence coding agents can be equipped with tools for checking their own work e.g. a linter, a boot probe, a shell, a screenshot tool. We call this set the agent's verification surface. This study asks whether increasing only that surface, with everything else held fixed, produces a matching growth in the quality of the software the agent ships. We built a minimal coding agent whose tool list is the single controlled variable and used it to implement 1,116 web applications across six models and eight tool configurations. A condition-blind human graded every application against a frozen rubric, and automatic probes stress-tested the API-observable behaviors. Verification's cheapest benefit arrives first, which is to make sure that the application comes up. Without any tools, about one build in seven fails to launch at all and a single boot probe removes nearly all of these failures at roughly 35 percent of a full shell's token cost, while the full shell multiplies the no-tools cost by 2.35. Screenshots help most where mistakes are visible (e.g. element placement, interaction), though even there the gain over a shell is modest and does not survive correction for multiple statistical comparisons. In cases where failures can only be measured rather than seen, such as keeping scrolling smooth over a 100,000-row list, screenshots add nothing. A verification tool improves the output artifact only where its reach covers the way the application actually fails. arXiv:2608.28828 (*cross-listing*) Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 19:57:26 GMT (89kb) Title: Representation Learning with Quantum Signal Processing Authors: Junqi Wang and Junyu Liu Categories: quant-ph cs.AI cs.LG stat.ML ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ We conducted an interview study with twelve students on their use of generative AI in academic communication. Students delegated professional messages to AI most where the pressure to sound professional is highest: email to instructors and administrators. AI involvement ranged from correcting the writer's own text to working out and writing the message outright, and students checked AI-written text against two criteria: whether it looks like AI and whether it sounds like them. Building on these findings, we model the AI-mediated process of writing a student--instructor email at the highest level of involvement we observed, and compare it with an unaided model of writing the same messages, built from participants' accounts and a classic model of the writing process. Three differences emerge: the learning loop that builds writing skill is removed, the message is no longer written for its specific recipient, and the confidence a successful exchange returns goes to using the system rather than to the writer's own ability. From these differences we derive two risks, that individual capacities never form and that authenticity and trust in communication become work. Design can respond to both but is unlikely to be enough, so the risks also need research and policy attention. arXiv:2608.28844 (*cross-listing*) Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 20:31:00 GMT (2363kb) Title: Toward Postural State Classification in Immersive VR with Multimodal Data and Explainability Analysis Authors: Nipa Anjum, Md Irfan Pavel, Robert Gonzalez Jr, Kevin Desai, Alberto Cordova, M. Rasel Mahmud, John Quarles Categories: cs.HC cs.AI cs.LG Comments: Accepted in The 25th IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality (ISMAR) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This paper develops a hybrid offline-online multi-agent reinforcement learning framework based on decision transformers. The policy is first pretrained offline via supervised sequence modeling of trajectories generated by existing policies, providing a safe and sample-efficient initialization. It is then fine-tuned online using a hybrid objective that incorporates critic-guided gradients, enabling performance improvements beyond the offline policy. To facilitate stable offline-to-online transfer and effective multi-agent coordination, the framework incorporates return-weighted sampling, a critic conditioned on neighbors' actions, and neighborhood-correlated exploration. The approach is fully distributed: both training and execution rely only on local observations and limited information exchange among neighboring agents. Evaluations with dynamic traffic arrivals in two settings: (i) joint scheduling and power allocation and (ii) coordinated beamforming, show that the proposed method achieves quality-of-service (QoS) performance comparable to centralized methods. Moreover, when pretrained on lower-quality datasets, online fine-tuning is also observed to surpass the initial offline policy. These results demonstrate a promising learning-based alternative for wireless resource management. arXiv:2608.28907 (*cross-listing*) Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 22:14:59 GMT (1048kb) Title: Structured State Reconciliation for Human-AI Task Handover Authors: Kayleigh Bishop, Maria P. arxiv:2607.25292.title_zh: 指令微调的语言模型无法从它们能描述的分布中采样
arxiv:2607.25292.summary_zh: 发现指令微调后的语言模型虽然能描述概率分布，但在实际采样时存在系统性偏差，无法忠实反映所描述的分布。
arxiv:2607.25292.insight_zh: 在利用LLM进行地理空间数据增强或情景模拟时，需警惕其采样偏差，可能影响生成数据的统计真实性。

arxiv:2607.25891.title: Messier: A High-Resolution Corpus for Cross-Benchmark Agent Evaluation
arxiv:2607.25891.reason: 构建高分辨率跨基准智能体评估语料库，与博士研究中多智能体系统的评估需求直接相关，可借鉴其评估框架。
arxiv:2607.25891.title_zh: Messier：用于跨基准智能体评估的高分辨率语料库
arxiv:2607.25891.summary_zh: 提出一个高分辨率语料库Messier，用于跨不同基准测试智能体性能，提供更细粒度的评估维度。
arxiv:2607.25891.insight_zh: 该语料库可能为城市更新中的多智能体协作提供标准化评估工具，但需关注其任务场景与地理空间领域的适配性。

arxiv:2607.26465.title: MultivationBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Sequential Motivation Reasoning
arxiv:2607.26465.reason: 研究多模态序列动机推理基准，与博士研究中多源数据融合和时空数据挖掘有交叉，可启发对多模态地理数据的推理建模。
arxiv:2607.26465.title_zh: MultivationBench：多模态序列动机推理基准
arxiv:2607.26465.summary_zh: 提出一个基准测试MultivationBench，用于评估模型在多模态序列数据上进行动机推理的能力。
arxiv:2607.26465.insight_zh: 该基准可能促进对城市多模态数据（如影像、文本）中隐含动机的推理研究，但需扩展至地理空间上下文。

arxiv:2608.03276.title: TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning
arxiv:2608.03276.reason: 研究查询无关的KV缓存压缩技术，对提升LLM在长时间序列地理数据处理的效率有潜在应用价值。
arxiv:2608.03276.title_zh: TaskPress：通过任务引导剪枝实现查询无关的KV缓存压缩
arxiv:2608.03276.summary_zh: 提出TaskPress方法，通过任务引导的剪枝策略压缩KV缓存，且不依赖具体查询，提升LLM推理效率。
arxiv:2608.03276.insight_zh: 该技术可降低LLM处理大规模时空数据的计算成本，但需验证在动态地理任务中的压缩效果。

arxiv:2608.03627.title: Unequal Verdicts: Investigating Gender Bias in LLM-Based Fake News Detection
arxiv:2608.03627.reason: 研究LLM在假新闻检测中的性别偏见，对博士研究中利用LLM进行地理空间信息可信度评估有警示作用。
arxiv:2608.03627.title_zh: 不平等的判决：调查基于LLM的假新闻检测中的性别偏见
arxiv:2608.03627.summary_zh: 调查发现基于LLM的假新闻检测系统存在性别偏见，影响检测结果的公平性。
arxiv:2608.03627.insight_zh: 在构建地理空间信息验证系统时，需注意LLM可能引入的偏见，确保决策的公正性。

arxiv:2608.06621.title: NxN E-valuation: Hypothesis Certification via a Conformal CRT Null
arxiv:2608.06621.reason: 提出共形CRT零分布下的假设认证方法，与博士研究中时空数据统计推断方法有方法论上的联系。
arxiv:2608.06621.title_zh: NxN评估：通过共形CRT零分布进行假设认证
arxiv:2608.06621.summary_zh: 提出一种基于共形推断和条件随机检验的假设认证方法，用于控制错误发现率。
arxiv:2608.06621.insight_zh: 该方法可为城市更新中的空间统计检验提供更稳健的框架，但需适配地理数据的空间依赖性。

arxiv:2608.06714.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
arxiv:2608.06714.reason: 提出将优化器视为智能体，通过推理驱动搜索跨提示、程序和ML工作流，与博士研究中多智能体系统和LLM驱动的自动化高度相关。
arxiv:2608.06714.title_zh: 优化器即智能体：跨提示、程序和ML工作流的推理驱动搜索
arxiv:2608.06714.summary_zh: 提出一种新范式，将优化器建模为智能体，利用推理驱动搜索来优化提示、程序及ML工作流。
arxiv:2608.06714.insight_zh: 该范式可能推动城市更新中多智能体系统的自主优化，但需验证在复杂地理空间任务中的可扩展性。

arxiv:2608.07438.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
arxiv:2608.07438.reason: 研究情感敏感认知架构与冲突感知记忆，对博士研究中构建具有社会感知能力的多智能体系统有直接启发。
arxiv:2608.07438.title_zh: PsychoAgent：面向LLM智能体的情感敏感认知架构与冲突感知记忆
arxiv:2608.07438.summary_zh: 提出PsychoAgent架构，使LLM智能体具备情感敏感性和冲突感知记忆，以增强交互的适应性。
arxiv:2608.07438.insight_zh: 该架构可能提升城市更新中多智能体对居民情感和冲突的响应能力，但需结合真实社会数据验证。

arxiv:2608.09512.title: Renormalising Generative Models for Active Inference: Foundations, Derivations, and Verification
arxiv:2608.09512.reason: 研究生成模型的重归一化用于主动推理，与博士研究中地理空间智能的理论基础有间接关联。
arxiv:2608.09512.title_zh: 用于主动推理的生成模型重归一化：基础、推导与验证
arxiv:2608.09512.summary_zh: 提供生成模型重归一化的理论基础和推导，用于主动推理框架，并进行了验证。
arxiv:2608.09512.insight_zh: 该理论可能为地理空间智能中的自适应决策提供新视角，但应用场景尚需明确。

arxiv:2608.15071.title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents
arxiv:2608.15071.reason: 该研究涉及LLM和多智能体自进化，与GIS研究中利用LLM和多智能体进行时空数据挖掘和城市更新分析有间接关联，但主题并非直接针对地理空间智能。
arxiv:2608.15071.title_zh: Evo-Harness：面向自进化智能体的上下文到技能编译
arxiv:2608.15071.summary_zh: 提出Evo-Harness框架，通过上下文到技能的编译机制，使智能体能够从交互上下文中提取并编译可复用技能，实现自进化能力提升。
arxiv:2608.15071.insight_zh: 该框架可能启发GIS多智能体系统从历史分析任务中自动提取和复用空间分析流程，提升城市更新决策支持的自动化水平。

arxiv:2608.15147.title: Constitutive Priors for Machine Intelligence: A Legitimacy Theory of the Artificial Physical World
arxiv:2608.15147.reason: 该文探讨机器智能的构成性先验和合法性理论，属于AI哲学基础，与GIS应用和时空数据挖掘的直接关联较弱。
arxiv:2608.15147.title_zh: 机器智能的构成性先验：人工物理世界的合法性理论
arxiv:2608.15147.summary_zh: 提出一种合法性理论框架，为人工物理世界中的机器智能提供构成性先验，探讨智能系统在物理世界中的合法运作基础。
arxiv:2608.15147.insight_zh: 该理论可能为GIS中部署自主地理空间智能体提供伦理和合法性设计参考，但需进一步结合具体应用场景。

arxiv:2608.23978.title: When Seeing Is Not Enough: Benchmarking Interactive Visual Grounding in LVLMs
arxiv:2608.23978.reason: 该论文研究LVLM在交互式视觉定位中的表现，涉及多轮对话、信息获取和视觉匹配，与GIS中基于自然语言的地理空间交互和智能制图相关。
arxiv:2608.23978.title_zh: 当看见不够时：LVLM中交互式视觉定位的基准测试
arxiv:2608.23978.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一个用于大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）交互式视觉定位的受控评估框架，变化了预先提供的目标信息量和需要通过对话获取的信息量。研究发现，当前LVLM在四种人类视觉情境和四种交互协议下的表现显著低于人类基线。交互在后续问题能细化或修正初始描述时有帮助，但当没有初始描述且必须通过提问获取目标信息时，性能最低。LVLM的置信度校准也较差。
arxiv:2608.23978.insight_zh: 该研究揭示了当前LVLM在主动提问式视觉定位上的不足，这为GIS中开发更自然、更智能的地理空间对话交互系统指明了挑战和方向。

arxiv:2608.24888.title: SimGuide: Typed Multi-Context User Representations for Preference-Conditioned Agent Planning
arxiv:2608.24888.reason: 该研究关注用户表示格式对智能体规划的影响，与LLM和多智能体系统相关，对城市更新中的个性化服务设计有潜在启发，但非直接GIS主题。
arxiv:2608.24888.title_zh: SimGuide：用于偏好条件智能体规划的类型化多上下文用户表示
arxiv:2608.24888.summary_zh: 该论文提出SIMGUIDE方法，将用户上下文结构化为类型化的领域特定块（Sims），并用程序化示例进行约束，实验表明这种表示格式比传统扁平化或检索增强方法更能提升智能体的偏好遵循度。
arxiv:2608.24888.insight_zh: 用户表示的结构化格式而非内容本身是影响智能体个性化表现的关键因素，这提示在设计用户模型时，应重视信息的组织方式。

arxiv:2608.24921.title: post-graph-rag: A PostgreSQL-Native Bi-Temporal Graph RAG Engine with Temporal Grounding at Synthesis
arxiv:2608.24921.reason: 该论文提出基于PostgreSQL的图RAG引擎，支持时间感知的知识图谱构建和查询，与时空数据挖掘和LLM应用高度相关，对地理空间知识图谱构建有参考价值。
arxiv:2608.24921.title_zh: post-graph-rag：具有合成时时间锚定的PostgreSQL原生双时态图RAG引擎
arxiv:2608.24921.summary_zh: 提出一个开源图RAG引擎，将文本块、实体图和社区摘要统一存储在PostgreSQL中，通过提取时不变式和时态层支持关系时效性和事实更替，相比LightRAG构建了更密集和可查询的图。
arxiv:2608.24921.insight_zh: 将时间维度纳入图RAG的知识图谱构建和查询，为处理随时间演化的地理空间事实提供了重要思路。

arxiv:2608.25100.title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
arxiv:2608.25100.reason: 该文研究LLM的知识编辑，与LLM在地理空间智能中的应用相关，但主要聚焦于模型内部知识更新，与城市更新和遥感变化检测的直接关联有限。
arxiv:2608.25100.title_zh: 通过多目标强化学习实现可靠、泛化且特定的上下文知识编辑
arxiv:2608.25100.summary_zh: 本文提出MO-IKE，一种多目标强化学习算法，将上下文知识编辑的提示构建形式化为约束马尔可夫决策过程。MO-IKE训练动态检索器以优化可靠性、泛化性和特异性等竞争目标，实现更平衡和全局连贯的提示构建。在Llama-3.2上，MO-IKE提升了编辑成功率、释义一致性和保留率。
arxiv:2608.25100.insight_zh: 多目标强化学习框架为LLM知识更新中的多目标平衡提供了思路，可启发地理空间知识库的动态维护与更新策略。

arxiv:2608.26849.title: LiveSim: Simulating Environment-Shaped Users in Multi-Agent Live-Stream Ecosystems
arxiv:2608.26849.reason: 研究基于LLM的多智能体用户行为模拟，特别是环境对用户行为的塑造，与多智能体系统和社会模拟相关，但应用场景为直播，与城市更新的直接关联有限。
arxiv:2608.26849.title_zh: LiveSim：模拟多智能体直播生态中受环境塑造的用户
arxiv:2608.26849.summary_zh: 针对现有用户行为模拟器依赖静态用户画像的不足，提出LiveSim，旨在模拟直播等社交密集环境中用户行为如何被持续变化的互动动态所重塑。
arxiv:2608.26849.insight_zh: 在动态社交环境中，用户行为模拟需要考虑环境对用户画像的实时塑造作用，而非仅依赖历史静态数据，这对于构建更真实的社会模拟系统至关重要。

arxiv:2608.27010.title: A Multi-Modal AI Framework for Real-Time Queue Prediction, Management and Optimisation in Intelligent Border Control Systems
arxiv:2608.27010.reason: 论文提出了一种多模态AI框架，用于边境控制系统的实时队列预测和管理，集成了LSTM预测和MPC优化。该方法在动态交通管理方面有应用价值，与城市更新中的交通流预测和资源优化有相似之处，但应用场景是边境控制而非城市环境。
arxiv:2608.27010.title_zh: 用于智能边境控制系统实时队列预测、管理和优化的多模态AI框架
arxiv:2608.27010.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种多模态AI框架，通过LSTM网络进行队列预测，并利用模型预测控制（MPC）和调度优化来生成控制策略。在合成数据上的评估显示，该方法相比ARIMA和基于规则的方法，将队列预测误差降低了35%，平均等待时间减少了30%，吞吐量提高了近20%。
arxiv:2608.27010.insight_zh: 结合LSTM的预测能力和MPC的优化能力，可以实现对动态交通状况的主动和自适应管理，显著提升系统效率。

arxiv:2608.27580.title: LongGuard: Mechanistic Analysis and Training-Free Mitigation of Long-Context Failure in Safety Guardrails
arxiv:2608.27580.reason: 该研究针对大语言模型安全护栏在长上下文下的失效问题，提出评估、机制分析和缓解框架，其方法论（注意力-逻辑-行为链分析）对理解复杂模型在长序列下的行为退化具有参考意义，但与GIS和遥感核心领域关联度中等。
arxiv:2608.27580.title_zh: LongGuard：安全护栏长上下文失效的机制分析与免训练缓解
arxiv:2608.27580.summary_zh: 安全护栏是抵御大语言模型有害输入和输出的最后防线，但通常在短文本上训练和评估。本文提出LongGuard框架，用于评估、机制分析和缓解长上下文护栏失效。任务被定义为在0.25k-32k长度网格上的安全针在大海捞针（SafetyNIAH）。在15个主流护栏中，不安全召回率平均单调下降超过50%。通过配对设计将失效归因于不安全针的比例稀释而非绝对长度。对六个护栏的三层注意力-逻辑-行为分析定位了机制：不安全针上的注意力质量被稀释，不安全/安全逻辑边际同步压缩，检测决策随之崩溃。进一步隔离了一组护栏特化的检索头。基于分析，提出两种免训练缓解方法（分块检测CD和注意力头锐化AHS）以及部署协议（上下文感知超参数路由CAHR）。在五个基准上，CAHR-CD和CAHR-AHS分别将六护栏平均性能提升22%和13%。
arxiv:2608.27580.insight_zh: 长上下文下安全护栏的失效源于注意力稀释和逻辑边际压缩，而非绝对长度，这提示在处理长序列数据时需关注关键信息的相对比例和模型内部状态变化。

arxiv:2608.27831.title: RealSWE: A Compositional Evaluation of Coding Agents under Realistic User Requests
arxiv:2608.27831.reason: 论文评估编码智能体在真实用户请求下的表现，涉及LLM评估方法论，与GIS研究中LLM应用评估有一定方法学参考价值，但主题非地理空间。
arxiv:2608.27831.title_zh: RealSWE：真实用户请求下编码智能体的组合式评估
arxiv:2608.27831.summary_zh: 定义了六类信息分类法和四个语言风格维度，应用于真实用户提示和基准问题。发现88%的真实提示仅包含问题陈述，而基准中仅占7%；87%的真实提示为随意风格。基于此构建了381个多变量任务族，评估七个当代LLM，发现真实输入平均降低解决率6.4个百分点，且明确陈述期望行为和动机能显著提升性能。
arxiv:2608.27831.insight_zh: 真实用户请求与基准任务在信息构成和语言风格上存在显著差异，明确陈述期望行为和动机对提升LLM软件工程性能至关重要，提示评估基准需更贴近真实场景。

arxiv:2608.27906.title: Rubric-to-Code Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv:2608.27906.reason: 该论文提出了一种用于代码生成的强化学习框架，与LLM应用相关，但主题是Web应用生成，与城市更新、遥感或地理空间智能的直接关联较弱。
arxiv:2608.27906.title_zh: 用于强化学习的评分标准到代码的信用分配
arxiv:2608.27906.summary_zh: 提出RCCA框架，将基于评分标准的反馈转化为代码生成的局部优化信号，以改进标准GRPO在代码生成任务中信用分配不佳的问题。该框架使用分层奖励区分格式、源代码、运行时和功能故障，并利用评估器生成的文本归因来对齐代码片段。由此产生的模型Ling-RCCA-Flash在MiniAppBench和ArtifactsBench上取得了领先成绩。
arxiv:2608.27906.insight_zh: 在复杂的代码生成任务中，将粗粒度的整体奖励分解为细粒度的、与代码区域对齐的反馈信号，可以显著提升模型性能，这为其他需要精细反馈的生成任务提供了方法论参考。

arxiv:2608.28062.title: WeAgent-MMSearch: Native Text-Vision Interaction for Multimodal Search Agents
arxiv:2608.28062.reason: 论文涉及多模态搜索智能体的构建与训练，其智能体框架和训练方法对地理空间智能中的多模态信息检索与决策有一定参考价值。
arxiv:2608.28062.title_zh: WeAgent-MMSearch：用于多模态搜索智能体的原生文本-视觉交互
arxiv:2608.28062.summary_zh: 论文提出了一个支持原生文本-视觉交互和运行时恢复的多模态智能体框架WeAgent-Harness，并基于此开发了集成系统WeAgent-MMSearch。该系统通过数据构建、智能体后训练和多模态rollout，提升了多模态搜索的性能，并引入了新的基准VisTarget-Bench。
arxiv:2608.28062.insight_zh: 该研究强调了在智能体交互中保留视觉信息的重要性，并提出了处理长程交互中异常rollout的方法，这对于构建更鲁棒的视觉-语言地理空间分析智能体具有启发意义。

arxiv:2608.28393.title: Timing-Aware Repurchase Prediction for Web-Scale E-Commerce: Survival Models for Multi-Surface Grocery Recommendation
arxiv:2608.28393.reason: 该研究使用生存模型预测电商回购时间，属于时序预测和推荐系统领域。与时空数据挖掘中的时序建模方法有共通之处，其处理时间到事件预测的思路可借鉴于地理时空事件预测。
arxiv:2608.28393.title_zh: 面向Web规模电商的时序感知回购预测：多界面杂货推荐生存模型

arxiv:2607.23648.title: EmoTrace: An Emotion Trajectory-Centered Framework for Psychological Support Dialogue Generation

arxiv:2607.26178.title: DuplexGen: Adaptive Synthesis of Human-AI Turn-Taking Dialogues

arxiv:2607.26178.title_zh: DuplexGen：自适应合成人机轮次切换对话

arxiv:2608.01017.title_zh: 为何LLM会妥协：医疗谄媚的对话因素与推理

arxiv:2608.01017.insight_zh: 该研究提醒在地理空间智能应用中需警惕LLM的谄媚偏差，确保决策客观性。

arxiv:2608.01291.title: ArabicDialectSafety: A Dialect-Aware Benchmark for Arabic Content Safety Classification
arxiv:2608.01291.reason: 针对阿拉伯语方言的内容安全分类，与城市更新和地理空间智能无直接关联。
arxiv:2608.01291.title_zh: ArabicDialectSafety：面向阿拉伯语内容安全分类的方言感知基准
arxiv:2608.01291.summary_zh: 构建一个方言感知的基准，用于评估阿拉伯语内容安全分类模型，可能涵盖多种方言变体。
arxiv:2608.01291.insight_zh: 方言感知方法或可借鉴于多语言地理文本分析，但当前研究领域差异大。

arxiv:2608.03044.title: Emulate or Estimate? The Divergent Strengths of Base and Post-Trained Language Models for Opinion Simulation
arxiv:2608.03044.reason: 比较基础与后训练语言模型在观点模拟上的差异，对多智能体系统中模拟公众意见有参考价值，与城市更新公众参与相关。
arxiv:2608.03044.title_zh: 模仿还是估计？基础与后训练语言模型在观点模拟中的不同优势
arxiv:2608.03044.summary_zh: 研究基础语言模型和后训练语言模型在模拟人类观点时的不同优势，可能涉及模型能力和训练策略的影响。
arxiv:2608.03044.insight_zh: 该研究可为城市更新中利用LLM模拟居民观点提供模型选择依据，但需注意模拟的局限性。

arxiv:2608.03437.title: Dynamically Allocating Evaluation Effort for Model Ranking
arxiv:2608.03437.reason: 研究模型排名中的评估资源动态分配，与地理空间模型评估方法相关，但非核心领域。
arxiv:2608.03437.title_zh: 动态分配评估努力以进行模型排名
arxiv:2608.03437.summary_zh: 提出一种动态分配评估资源的方法，以高效地对模型进行排名，可能通过自适应采样减少评估成本。
arxiv:2608.03437.insight_zh: 该方法可优化地理空间模型的评估流程，但需结合具体任务验证。

arxiv:2608.09538.title: TCS-BENCH: Benchmarking State-of-the-Art Generative AI Theoretical Computer Science Research Ability
arxiv:2608.09538.reason: 评估生成式AI在理论计算机科学上的研究能力，与LLM能力评估相关，但非地理空间应用。
arxiv:2608.09538.title_zh: TCS-BENCH：基准测试最先进生成式AI的理论计算机科学研究能力

arxiv:2608.10678.title: Auditing Chinese Web-scale Corpora via Sampled BPE Token Statistics
arxiv:2608.10678.reason: 审计中文网络语料库的BPE标记统计，与多源数据融合和数据质量相关，对地理文本数据预处理有参考。
arxiv:2608.10678.title_zh: 通过采样BPE标记统计审计中文网络规模语料库
arxiv:2608.10678.summary_zh: 通过采样BPE（字节对编码）标记统计来审计中文大规模网络语料库，可能涉及数据质量、偏差或隐私问题。
arxiv:2608.10678.insight_zh: 该方法可应用于地理文本语料的质量评估，但需注意领域特定性。

arxiv:2608.10690.title: Can Released LLM Vocabularies Support Token-Level Estimation of Hidden Corpora?
arxiv:2608.10690.reason: 研究LLM词汇表与隐藏语料库的估计，与时空数据挖掘中的文本分析有一定关联，但主题偏离GIS和遥感核心。
arxiv:2608.10690.title_zh: 发布的LLM词汇表能否支持隐藏语料库的Token级估计？
arxiv:2608.10690.summary_zh: 探讨利用已发布的大型语言模型词汇表来估计隐藏语料库的token级统计信息。
arxiv:2608.10690.insight_zh: 该方法可能为从公开模型输出中推断数据分布提供新思路，但需验证其在不同语料库上的泛化能力。

arxiv:2608.10810.title: Surfacing the Unsaid: CUE-Bench for Affective Stance in Chinese Discourse
arxiv:2608.10810.reason: 涉及中文话语中的情感立场，与地理文本情感分析有间接联系，但非GIS核心。
arxiv:2608.10810.title_zh: 揭示未言之意：中文话语情感立场的CUE-Bench基准
arxiv:2608.10810.summary_zh: 提出CUE-Bench基准，用于评估中文话语中的情感立场分析。
arxiv:2608.10810.insight_zh: 该基准可能有助于改进中文社交媒体地理文本的情感分析，但需结合地理上下文。

arxiv:2608.11573.title: Reinforcing Step-level Reasoning for Effective Self-Correction in LLMs
arxiv:2608.11573.reason: 关注LLM的推理和自我修正，与多智能体系统中的决策优化相关，但非直接GIS。
arxiv:2608.11573.title_zh: 强化步骤级推理以有效实现LLM自我修正
arxiv:2608.11573.summary_zh: 研究如何通过强化步骤级推理来提升LLM在自我修正任务中的表现。
arxiv:2608.11573.insight_zh: 该方法可应用于多智能体地理分析中的错误纠正，但需进一步适配空间推理任务。

arxiv:2608.14843.title: Writing Style Similarity Reflects Academic Genealogy
arxiv:2608.14843.reason: 分析学术写作风格与学术谱系的关系，与地理学术文献计量有微弱关联。
arxiv:2608.14843.title_zh: 写作风格相似度反映学术谱系
arxiv:2608.14843.summary_zh: 研究学术论文写作风格相似度与学术谱系（导师-学生关系）之间的关联。

arxiv:2608.16344.title_zh: IndicQE-APE：印度语言质量评估与自动后编辑基准
arxiv:2608.16344.summary_zh: 为印度语言构建机器翻译质量评估和自动后编辑的基准数据集。
arxiv:2608.16344.insight_zh: 该基准可能对多语言地理信息翻译有参考，但非核心。

arxiv:2608.24080.title: When Less Is More: An Empirical Study of Minimal Responses in Counseling Dialogues and the Behavior of LLMs
arxiv:2608.24080.reason: 该研究分析LLM在心理咨询对话中的行为，与博士研究中LLM应用相关，但领域（心理健康）与GIS和城市更新研究关联度较低。
arxiv:2608.24080.title_zh: 少即是多：心理咨询对话中最小回应的实证研究及LLM行为分析
arxiv:2608.24080.summary_zh: 本文对多个心理咨询对话数据集中的最小回应进行了系统性跨语言分析，开发了一种基于话语长度和内容的两阶段过滤方法，并结合LLM进行上下文验证。研究发现，最小回应在人类收集的数据集中很常见，但在LLM生成的数据集中明显不足。评估显示，强大的商业LLM在明确指示下能生成最小回应，但难以判断何时使用合适；基于合成数据训练的咨询专用模型表现不佳，倾向于生成更长、信息更丰富的回应。此外，基于LLM的回应质量评估可能低估最小回应的价值。
arxiv:2608.24080.insight_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM在生成对话中对于交互性细微差别的理解不足，提示在特定领域应用中需要更精细的上下文感知和评估方法。

arxiv:2608.24621.title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding
arxiv:2608.24621.reason: 论文提出后果感知评估框架用于安全关键的语言理解任务（空中交通管制），与GIS中安全关键应用（如灾害响应）的评估方法有潜在关联，但主题领域不同。
arxiv:2608.24621.title_zh: 超越语义准确性：安全关键语言理解的后果感知评估
arxiv:2608.24621.summary_zh: 本文研究了在安全关键操作中，标准语义指标可能高估语言模型可靠性的问题。提出了一个后果感知评估框架，并在基于航空标准和40名管制员反馈的基准上评估了8个模型，揭示了语义-安全差距，并表明风险感知微调无法完全消除该差距。
arxiv:2608.24621.insight_zh: 在安全关键领域，标准NLP指标可能无法反映操作可靠性，后果感知评估是部署前必要的补充验证手段。

arxiv:2608.25089.title: Apples to Apples? Towards Comparable Crosslingual Language Model Evaluation
arxiv:2608.25089.reason: 论文关注跨语言模型评估的公平性，与LLM评估相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新，相关性较低。
arxiv:2608.25089.title_zh: 苹果对苹果？迈向可比较的跨语言语言模型评估
arxiv:2608.25089.summary_zh: 跨语言评估的公平比较是多语言NLP的基本挑战。现有研究采用各种下游任务和内在指标，但缺乏实证检验。本文使用在平行数据上训练的受控单语模型，系统检验了跨语言评估方法，发现多种广泛使用的归一化指标引入了源于分词、编码和正字法差异的跨语言偏差。相比之下，在语义等价序列上计算的句子级负对数似然提供了更有意义和一致的跨语言比较。
arxiv:2608.25089.insight_zh: 跨语言模型评估中，基于语义等价序列的句子级负对数似然比归一化指标更可靠，后者可能引入与语言结构相关的偏差。

arxiv:2608.25343.title: GUIDE: Generative Unsupervised Chinese Query Correction via Phonetic and Visual Shared-ID Encoding
arxiv:2608.25343.reason: 该研究关注中文查询纠错，与自然语言处理相关，但与地理空间或城市更新的直接关联较弱。
arxiv:2608.25343.title_zh: GUIDE：通过语音和视觉共享ID编码的生成式无监督中文查询纠错
arxiv:2608.25343.summary_zh: 针对中文查询纠错中监督数据成本高的问题，提出无监督方法GUIDE，利用语音和视觉共享ID编码，避免无约束生成导致的过度纠正和意图漂移。
arxiv:2608.25343.insight_zh: 在短查询场景中，无约束生成容易过度纠正，通过语音和视觉共享编码可以约束生成过程，保持查询意图。

arxiv:2608.26123.title: Which India Survives Translation? Narrative Homogenisation Across Indian Oral Traditions in LLMs
arxiv:2608.26123.reason: 该研究探讨LLM在不同文化叙事中的同质化问题，与多智能体系统中的LLM应用有一定关联，但主题与城市更新、遥感变化检测等核心研究方向相距较远。
arxiv:2608.26123.title_zh: 哪个印度在翻译中幸存？LLM中印度口头传统的叙事同质化
arxiv:2608.26123.summary_zh: 该研究通过计算分析，考察LLM在生成印度三种不同口头文学传统（拉贾斯坦史诗、泰米尔桑加姆诗歌、孟加拉民间故事）内容时的同质化现象。研究发现，尽管模型输出更接近各自传统，但跨传统相似度较高，表明存在部分同质化。意外的是，使用区域语言提示反而降低了与真实传统的保真度。
arxiv:2608.26123.insight_zh: LLM在生成非西方文化内容时存在叙事同质化倾向，且区域语言提示不一定能提高文化保真度，这对多语言地理空间文本分析中的文化敏感性有启示。

arxiv:2608.26576.title: Double Trouble: Bilingual Pretraining Leaves Language-Conditioned Effects in Shared-Language Representations
arxiv:2608.26576.reason: 该文探讨了多语言模型共享语言表示的可比性问题，对跨语言迁移和模型可解释性研究有参考价值，但与GIS和遥感核心主题关联较弱。
arxiv:2608.26576.title_zh: 双重问题：双语预训练在共享语言表示中留下语言条件效应
arxiv:2608.26576.summary_zh: 该文通过对比仅英语和双语预训练的模型，发现即使在对齐嵌入空间后，模型用于预测的深层隐藏状态仍存在显著差异，且这种差异在中间层增长，表明其源于上下文处理而非输入表示。嵌入对齐可能掩盖模型内部表示的真实差异。
arxiv:2608.26576.insight_zh: 在跨语言模型比较或迁移时，仅对齐嵌入空间可能不足，需关注深层上下文表示的一致性。

arxiv:2608.26638.title: Which Metrics Save the Most Human Annotation? Prediction-Powered Evaluation and Meta-Evaluation
arxiv:2608.26638.reason: 该论文提出预测驱动评估框架，结合有限人类判断和大规模自动评分，与GIS中遥感变化检测的验证和评估方法有一定关联，可借鉴其数据效率思想。
arxiv:2608.26638.title_zh: 哪些指标节省最多人类标注？预测驱动评估与元评估
arxiv:2608.26638.summary_zh: 本文提出预测驱动评估框架，结合有限人类判断和大规模自动评分，获得数据高效且无偏的系统比较。作者开发了参数和非参数程序，分析了配对和非配对设计的效率权衡，并在六个WMT数据集上验证。还引入预测驱动节省比（PPSR）作为元指标，衡量自动指标在预测驱动评估中节省的人类标注量。
arxiv:2608.26638.insight_zh: 该框架可应用于遥感变化检测中，利用自动指标减少人工验证成本，提高评估效率。

arxiv:2608.27128.title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy
arxiv:2608.27128.reason: 该研究关注大语言模型推理中的KV缓存优化，属于模型推理效率领域。与GIS和遥感研究的核心方法关联度极低。
arxiv:2608.27128.title_zh: TwinKV：通过成对键冗余进行KV缓存驱逐的可组合修复通道
arxiv:2608.27128.summary_zh: 本文发现注意力大小与token对答案的因果贡献无关，并据此提出TwinKV，一种无需训练、无需注意力的冗余信号，用于检测token的键是否在上下文中存在近重复。TwinKV作为可组合的修复通道，在保持原有预算和评分规则的前提下，交换被驱逐的孤儿token和冗余捐赠者token。在多个基准和模型上的实验表明，TwinKV能提升多数配置下的性能。
arxiv:2608.27128.insight_zh: 该研究挑战了基于注意力的缓存驱逐方法，提出基于冗余的修复策略，但其核心问题与地理空间研究无关。

arxiv:2608.27380.title: D2C-Routing: Dimension-to-Composition Evidence Routing for Mixed-Origin AI-Generated Text Detection
arxiv:2608.27380.reason: 该论文专注于AI生成文本的检测，特别是混合来源文本，与GIS和遥感领域的核心研究主题关联度较低。
arxiv:2608.27380.title_zh: D2C-Routing：用于混合来源AI生成文本检测的维度到组合证据路由
arxiv:2608.27380.summary_zh: 论文提出D2C-Routing方法，将混合来源文本检测视为维度到组合的来源归属问题，分别推断内容来源和表达来源，再组合成四种协作类型。该方法在MixD2C基准上取得了优于基线模型的性能。
arxiv:2608.27380.insight_zh: 该研究揭示了区分AI内容/人类表达与完全AI生成文本是当前检测中最困难的边界。

arxiv:2608.27394.title: RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature
arxiv:2608.27394.reason: 该论文构建了面向科学文献的检索基准，其核心是支持不同抽象层次的灵感检索操作，这与GIS研究中利用LLM进行文献挖掘和知识发现的方法高度相关，尤其是在多智能体系统中作为知识检索组件。
arxiv:2608.27394.title_zh: RATIO：科学文献中类型化构思操作的检索基准

arxiv:2608.27481.title_zh: XHotpotQA：多跳问答中跨语言知识组合的基准

arxiv:2608.27481.insight_zh: 该基准揭示了多跳问答系统在语言边界上的失败模式，强调了在推理链中整合跨语言证据的挑战，为构建更鲁棒的知识组合系统提供了诊断工具。

arxiv:2608.28496.insight_zh: 顺序测试时扩展通过利用目标端上下文提升翻译质量，但其效果受预算和上下文构建方式影响，存在准确性下降的风险。
